officialCampingShelterNotes: Åkulla has two nearby shelters: Lägerplats Åkulla and the island shelter at Yasjön.
Yasjön island access is prohibited 1 March-30 June during bird nesting, and the cable ferry/raft normally operates 1 July to mid-October.
Kogstorp is the main on/near-route campsite about 4 km before Ullared, with shelter for 4-5 adults, fireplace, firewood store and dry toilet.
Björkasjö is a good shelter/toilet site but is an explicit detour and should not be imported as an on-route M1 facility without detour modeling.

closuresAndReroutes.caveat: Adjacent reroutes for Nösslinge - Åkulla and Åkulla - Ästad are listed, but not Åkulla - Ullared. Use the digital map/official GPX over June 2022 paper maps.

dogs.rule: Hallandsleden general guidance says dogs should be kept on a lead. From 1 March to 20 August, dogs must be leashed or under very strict supervision; this also applies in pastures with livestock.
Åkullaboket and nearby reserves prohibit unleashed dogs.

huntingForestryAndLandUse.note: Rules lane reports Hallandsleden notes hunting may occur August-January, with the first weeks of the season most intense and peak elk hunting at the beginning of October.
No active forestry closure or M1-specific hunting notice was found. The route uses forest roads and private/farm contexts; obey temporary local signs, machinery closures and hunting instructions.
Route passes farms/pastures. Close gates, keep distance from cattle/horses and be extra cautious around calves/foals.

roadAndUrbanSafety: Expect gravel/forest roads and farm access roads mid-stage, then paved road through Ullared after Musasjön.
Åkulla access is tied to road 153 and seasonal/remote bus access; be cautious when joining or leaving by road.
Ullared is an urban/commercial endpoint with heavy shopping traffic around Gekås and the bus terminal.
seasonalNotes: Åkturen to Åkulla is seasonal: 15 June through 16 August 2026.
Yasjön island shelter access is prohibited 1 March-30 June; cable ferry/raft normally operates 1 July to mid-October.
Åkullaboket southern reserve access can be limited in winter when ski tracks have snow; northern trails remain accessible according to the rules lane.
Fire risk rises spring/summer and current fire-ban status must be checked before import/runtime display.
